statements.status_notes: MQTT decoder resource exhaustion via oversized MQTT 5 Properties section. The netty-codec-mqtt jar is embedded inside the Cassandra Java driver shaded uber-jars (cql-*.jar, persistence-cassandra-4.0-*.jar). Stargate exposes CQL, gRPC, REST, GraphQL, and Document API transports; no MQTT listener exists and MqttDecoder is never instantiated. Upstream fix in 4.1.133.Final is pinned via mvn-properties netty.version, but the cassandra-driver shaded jars carry their own pre-shaded 4.1.132.Final copies that the property override cannot rewrite.
